topic: Fundamentals of Vectors: The Language of Space
target_audience: High school or introductory university students

sections.title: What is a Vector? (The Intuition)
lecture_lines: Vectors have both magnitude and direction.
Think of a drone's flight path.
animations: Animate vector arrow from origin to (2, 3) (#FFFF00).
Add text 'v' next to the arrow (#FFFF00).
Draw a dashed line showing magnitude (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Coordinate Representation & Components
lecture_lines: We use grids to map space.
animations: Draw horizontal dotted line to (3,0) and vertical to (0,2) (#00FF00).

sections.title: Vector Addition: The Head-to-Tail Rule
lecture_lines: Connect the head to the tail.
The result is a new vector.
animations: Animate vector 'v' starting from the tip of 'u' (#FF00FF).
Draw resultant vector 'u+v' from origin to tip of 'v' (#FFFFFF) and measure its magnitude using.

sections.title: Scalar Multiplication & Scaling
animations: Show vector doubling in length when multiplied by 2 (#FFFFFF).
